blogPosts.title: How to Maintain a Beautiful Garden in Melbourne's Variable Climate
blogPosts.excerpt: Learn essential garden maintenance tips for McKinnon homeowners to keep your outdoor spaces thriving through Melbourne's unpredictable weather.
body: Melbourne's climate is known for its variability, with hot summers and cool winters that can challenge garden maintenance in suburbs like McKinnon. To keep your garden beautiful year-round, start with understanding the local soil conditions. McKinnon's soil is often clay-based, which retains moisture but can become waterlogged, so incorporating organic matter like compost improves drainage and plant health.

Seasonal care is crucial; during summer, focus on watering early in the morning to reduce evaporation, and use mulch to retain moisture. In McKinnon, native Australian plants are excellent choices as they're adapted to local conditions and require less water. Our garden maintenance services include seasonal checks to ensure your plants thrive despite temperature swings.

Winter in Melbourne brings frost and cold winds, which can damage sensitive plants. Protect your garden by covering vulnerable areas with frost cloths and pruning back perennials to encourage spring growth. McKinnon gardeners often use windbreaks like hedges, which we can trim and maintain to provide shelter for your plants.

Regular lawn mowing is essential in McKinnon, especially during the growing seasons of spring and autumn. Keep grass at an optimal height of about 3-4 centimetres to promote deep root growth and drought resistance. Our team uses eco-friendly equipment to minimise noise and environmental impact while keeping your lawn in top condition.

Pest management is another key aspect of garden maintenance in McKinnon. Common issues like aphids or snails can be addressed with natural remedies, such as neem oil or copper barriers. We integrate sustainable practices into our services to avoid harmful chemicals, ensuring a safe space for pets and children in your outdoor areas.

Finally, planning for long-term garden health involves regular assessments. In McKinnon, we recommend quarterly reviews to adapt to changing weather patterns and plant needs. By investing in professional garden maintenance, you not only enhance your property's appeal but also contribute to a greener, more resilient local environment.
